name: Pan-Seared Trout with Ginger-Soy Sauce
description: A lower-calorie, high-protein trout dinner with a Thermomix-prepared ginger-soy sauce.
steps: Pat the trout fillets dry. Season lightly with pepper; add little or no salt because the sauce contains soy sauce.
Add ginger and garlic to the Thermomix mixing bowl. Chop 5 sec/speed 7. Scrape down the bowl.
Add soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup or honey, lime juice, water and sesame oil. Mix 10 sec/speed 4.
Cook the sauce 4 min/90°C/speed 1, measuring cup off. Transfer to a small serving jug and keep warm.
Heat a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add 1 tsp neutral oil.
Place trout skin-side down if skin-on. Cook about 4-5 minutes, pressing gently for the first 20 seconds so the skin remains flat.
Turn the fillets and cook about 1-3 minutes more, depending on thickness, until just cooked through and still moist.
Plate immediately. Spoon a modest amount of warm ginger-soy sauce over each fillet and garnish with green onion and optional sesame seeds.

nutrition.note: Approximate; varies with fillet size and amount of sauce used.
